name: XCC_REV_FUND_REQUEST_RULES
description: This table contains a record for each control budget and revenue funding rule processed by the create expense budget entry from revenue enterprise service scheduler process request. The create expense budget entry from revenue report displays the results of this process request using this data.

columns.name: REV_FUNDING_REQUEST_RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the process request, control budget and revenue funding rule.

columns.name: REV_FUNDING_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the create expense budget entry from revenue process job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CONTROL_BUDGET_ID
columns.description: Control budget identifier of the revenue funding rule.

columns.name: REV_FUNDING_RULE_ID
columns.description: Revenue funding rule identifier.

columns.name: REV_FUNDING_SOURCE_LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Primary or secondary ledger identifier with the earned or collected revenue source amounts.

columns.name: BUDGET_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Budget period of the control budget derived from the accounting period of the process request.

columns.name: BUDGET_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency assigned to the control budget.

columns.name: MIN_REV_THRESHOLD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the method used to determine the minimum revenue threshold amount.

columns.name: MIN_REV_BUDGET_SCENARIO
columns.description: GL budget scenario with the revenue estimate amounts used to determine the minimum revenue threshold amount.

columns.name: MIN_REV_AMOUNT
columns.description: Minimum revenue amount at the time of the process request. Either the amount specified by the user as the minimum funding threshold or the sum of all the revenue budget amounts in the GL budget scenario for the revenue source accounting combinations of the revenue funding rule.

columns.name: MAX_FUNDING_LIMIT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the method used to determine the maximum funding threshold amount.

columns.name: MAX_FUNDING_BUDGET_SCENARIO
columns.description: GL budget scenario with the revenue estimate amounts used to determine the maximum funding threshold amount.

columns.name: MAX_FUNDING_AMOUNT
columns.description: Maximum funding amount at the time of the process request. Either the amount specified by the user as the maximum funding threshold or the sum of all the revenue budget amounts in the GL budget scenario for the revenue source accounting combinations of the revenue funding rule.

columns.name: REVENUE_SOURCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Sum of the source ledger GL balances for the accounting period of the process and all the revenue source account combinations of the revenue funding rule at the time of the process request.

columns.name: REVENUE_FUNDING_AMOUNT
columns.description: Calculated budget entry amount for the revenue funding rule and process request.

columns.name: RESULT_CODE
columns.description: Processing result for the rule.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE_CODE
columns.description: Error code when the processing of the rule has an error.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: BUDGET_PERIOD_YEAR
columns.description: Indicates the budget year of the accumulated funding amount for the control budget and revenue funding rule used in the process request.

columns.name: ACCUMULATED_FUNDING_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of funding from revenue added to the budget for the control budget, revenue funding rule and budget year at the time of the process request.
